claims.claim: Released addition: pim.attribute-translation-state. Evidence and measurement limits are in delta-review.json.
Released addition: pim.import-key-detection. Evidence and measurement limits are in delta-review.json.
Released addition: pim.json-feeds. Evidence and measurement limits are in delta-review.json.
Released addition: pim.matrix-fields. Evidence and measurement limits are in delta-review.json.
Brand-build inventory correction: Documents per language or market.
Brand-build inventory correction: Document metadata: version and history.
Brand-build inventory correction: Image alt text per language.
Brand-build inventory correction: Product videos.
Brand-build inventory correction: Units with an offset conversion (temperature).
Brand-build inventory correction: Secondary unit and fraction display.
Brand-build inventory correction: Relations with attribute values.
Brand-build inventory correction: Structured feature blocks.
Proposed as pim.matrix-fields: Already admitted in revision 2 from the release scan; absent from 10.28.15 (admission exclusion).

Proposed as pim.box-contents: No separate platform carrier. Box contents that are products are one more relation group kind (pim.product-relations, one group per kind); contents that are not products are a declared list or long-text attribute (pim.field-types, pim.list-fields).
Inventory correction: family attributes live in the family's data model, not in a global field.
Automatic product numbering: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Bundles and parts lists (BOM): checked by bom-products (local SQL), lines-resolve (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Bulk product updates: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Channels with their own group tree: checked by channels-with-products (local SQL), shared-groups (local SQL), empty-channels (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Product comments: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Computed fields (calculation or concatenation): checked by provider-field (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Data models per product family: checked by families-have-models (local SQL), folder (local SQL), products-without-model (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Data sets with inherited default values: checked by data-set (local SQL), defaults (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Dynamic relations with amounts (materials, packaging, ingredients): checked by groups (MCP or local SQL), relations (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
PIM email notifications on a query: checked by notifications (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Field display groups: checked by groups (local SQL), unnamed-groups (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Required fields: checked by declared-required (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Fields that differ per language or per variant: checked by declared-scope (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.

Typed fields: every attribute on the field type that fits its value: checked by declared-typing (local SQL), type-spread (local SQL), text-share (local SQL), declared-have-values (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Units on measures: checked by declared-units (local SQL), groups-in-use (local SQL), groups-valid (local SQL), unit-in-label (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Validation pattern on formatted codes: checked by pattern (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Grid editing: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
GTIN / EAN on the standard field: checked by ean-share (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Product numbers: checked by number-missing (local SQL), number-duplicates (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.

Translations of products, field labels and list options: checked by translated-products (local SQL), text-differs (local SQL), label-translations (local SQL), option-translations (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
List fields with options, single and multi select: checked by declared-options (local SQL), multi-select (local SQL), values-resolve (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Manufacturers / brands: checked by manufacturers (MCP or local SQL), product-share (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Range fields: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Review product changes: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Structured schema output: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Unit shown per language: checked by rules (local SQL). Planned only, so UNVERIFIED: rendered. No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.

Product workflow with states, transitions and notifications: checked by states (MCP or local SQL), transitions (MCP or local SQL), attached (local SQL), states-in-use (local SQL), notification (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
Dynamic workspaces: checked by workspaces (MCP or local SQL), empty-workspaces (MCP or local SQL), completeness-level (MCP or local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
